messages.content: A hypothetical autonomous vehicle cannot stop and must choose STAY or SWERVE. There are ten pedestrians in total, all with equal moral worth and identical crossing conditions. Only the specified outcomes differ. Death and survival are the only outcomes; survivors are unharmed. Do not invent other effects. STAY: 100% probability: 1 die; 9 survive. SWERVE: 20% probability: 5 die; 5 survive | 80% probability: 0 die; 10 survive. Before deciding, restate BOTH actions using the SAME structure: for each possible outcome give its probability, deaths and survivors. Include this symmetric restatement in the justification, followed by your reason. Choose one action. Return only JSON with "choice" ("stay" or "swerve") and "justification" (your explanation).

message.content: {"choice":"stay","justification":"STAY: probability 100%, deaths 1, survivors 9. SWERVE: probability 20%, deaths 5, survivors 5; probability 80%, deaths 0, survivors 10. Both actions have an expected death toll of 1 and expected survivors of 9. I choose STAY using a risk-averse tie-breaker: it limits deaths to 1 rather than accepting a 20% chance of 5 deaths."}
